name: Barov Family Fortune
summary: Weldon Barov asks you to recover the Barov family fortune from Scholomance. Four deeds make up the fortune, naming lands from Caer Darrow to Southshore.

sections.title: The Four Deeds
sections.body: The fortune is made up of four deeds: Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore. Weldon Barov asks you to recover them from Scholomance and return to him when you have gathered the fortune.

faq.q: What is the Barov family fortune?
faq.answer: The Barov family fortune consists of deeds to Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore.
Weldon Barov asks you to recover the Barov family fortune.
The deeds are to be recovered from Scholomance.

faq.q: Which deeds make up the fortune?
faq.answer: The fortune includes deeds to Caer Darrow, Brill, Tarren Mill, and Southshore.

faq.q: Where do I take the deeds?
faq.answer: Return the recovered fortune to Weldon Barov.
